distribution_shift.test_note: Test statistics are descriptive warnings only; no feature or modelling decision in this EDA uses them.

recommendations.recommendation: Judge every model against EWMA (alpha 0.2) on the same test windows, in hours, overall and per port; the attainable gain is small (hourly noise SD 3.5–4.4 h vs EWMA RMSE 4.30 h on validation).
Keep the 12-hour window and a small model (1 recurrent layer, 16–64 units, dropout, early stopping on validation RMSE). Do not add depth, attention or graph structure without validation evidence.
Report errors separately for disruption / strike hours vs normal hours and for high-signal ports (NLRTM, USLAX, CNSHA, INNSA, SGSIN) vs noise-dominated ports (MYPKG, DEHAM, AEJEA, INMAA).

Treat labour_strike as fragile: only 4 strike episodes at 4 ports in train + val, while the test period contains strikes at INNSA and MYPKG, which never strike in development data. Run an ablation without it.

Use the default 8-channel loader input (with dwell_reconstructed); reconstruction showed no measurable effect, so a 7-channel ablation is a check, not a requirement. Use a port embedding or per-port reporting; keep per-port dwell scaling and compute the loss in scaled units but evaluate in hours.
